# IBM Plex Sans

The variable regular font is bundled at `website/src/main/resources/static/fonts/ibm-plex-sans.ttf`.
It includes Cyrillic and is served locally, without third-party font requests.

Source: [Google Fonts, IBM Plex Sans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ibmplexsans).
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in `OFL.txt`.
